pieces.file: Whitehead — rich — one occasion, then the society.m4a
pieces.title: One occasion, then the society
pieces.caption: One grain, alone. It arises and is gone. Again. Then they arrive faster, until near twelve seconds you stop hearing grains and hear a tone. Nothing in that tone persists: no grain lasts a tenth of a second. The tone is the pattern they hold together. *What is real and what is a choice:* The page's claim that the grain is the actual occasion and the cloud the society.

pieces.title: A page is built of what it takes up
pieces.caption: Whitehead's avatar in the middle of every page it holds a link with. Red for the six it takes up, grey for the seven that take it up in turn, each line naming the link. *What is real and what is a choice:* All thirteen links are real, map build of 2026-11-09. *Leaking in:* Its thirteen neighbours, Leibniz among them on a 'contradicts'.
